messages:
sara: Customer Acme Retail reporting Mar 15 invoice ~2x tokens vs dashboard. Ticket #SUP-3245. They're asking for refund/credit — quick triage?

oliver: Seeing spikes in the ledger around 2026-03-15 00:00 UTC and a batch at 2026-03-15 00:00 local. Some events appear in both daily windows. Suspect billing window offset after last deploy.

kai: Can you confirm which path used org timezone? Our streaming metering should be UTC. The rollup aggregator reads billing_day_start; fallback is supposed to be UTC.

sara: Acme org settings show timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'. Dashboard reporting uses UTC buckets. That mismatch can double-count events that straddle midnight local -> UTC boundary.

ben: Finance here — we need a provisional credit while eng investigates. Estimate of overcount please and a revrec note template for the adjustment.

oliver: Running quick dedupe query now. SQL snippet:

```sql
SELECT count(*)
FROM usage_events ue
WHERE ue.customer_id='acme' AND ue.event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-14T23:45:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T00:15:00Z'
GROUP BY ue.request_id HAVING count(*)>1;
```

Result: 1,872 duplicate request_ids -> approx 1.9M duplicated tokens (rough token mapping applied).

kai: :eyes: that matches. Root cause: nightly rollup used org tz to compute day buckets, but streaming path still used UTC. A deploy on 2026-03-10 changed one code path to use org tz incorrectly.

sara: Customer asks for full refund of duplicated tokens. Ben, can we issue provisional credit of $3,250 while we finish reconciliation? They need a statement for accounting.

ben: Provisional credit approved for $3,250. I'll log revrec note: 'Provisional customer credit pending metering reconciliation; final adjustment after dedupe verification.' Need ticket ID and owner for audit trail.

kai: I'll own remediation and the dedupe patch. Plan:
- run backfill to mark duplicate events
- recompute daily aggregates for Acme
- produce corrected invoice and post revrec
ETA 48h. Will post progress here.

oliver: Short-term mitigation: add guard in aggregator to prefer UTC buckets when org timezone != 'UTC' until we ship fix. Pushing hotfix to staging now.

billing-bot: Invoice correction PR created: PR#BILL-987. Notifying billing queue.

ben: Finance note to Acme drafted. Sara, can you send with provisional credit details and expected timeline (48-72h)? Include provisional revrec language.

sara: Sending now. Message to customer:

Hi @acme-account, we identified duplicated usage due to a timezone window mismatch in our billing pipeline. We've applied a provisional credit of $3,250 to your invoice while we complete reconciliation (expected 48-72h). We will follow up with corrected invoice and formal revrec note. —Sara (Support) :thumbsup:

acme-account: Thanks for the quick response. Please confirm final invoice by Mar 18. Appreciate the provisional credit.

kai: Noted. I'll include a short postmortem and tests to lock billing window logic to UTC-by-default and add end-to-end regression for org timezone handling. Will also attach logs and the dedupe query outputs for finance.

sara: Marking ticket #SUP-3245 as escalated -> ENG owner kai, FIN owner ben. Will update customer after dedupe run completes.

oliver: Follow-up: saved sample duplicate event lines for audit:
```
{request_id: "r-0xabc123", customer: "acme", event_time: "2026-03-15T00:01:12Z", bucket_day: "2026-03-15"}
{request_id: "r-0xabc123", customer: "acme", event_time: "2026-03-15T00:01:12-08:00", bucket_day: "2026-03-14"}
```

This demonstrates same request landing in two buckets.

ben: Logged provisional credit in billing ledger and added revrec placeholder entry id REV-2026-03-15-A. Finance will reconcile after final invoice.

kai: I'll keep this thread updated. Thanks team.
